messages:
elaine_pm: Quick sync — heads-up collecting scope for 'multi-step toolflows'. Customers asking for fan-out to 3rd-party APIs, per-call retries, ordering constraints, and fine-grained timeout controls. Need to prioritize for Q2 roadmap.

ryan_eng: Proposal — split into 3 priority lanes: 1) ordered transactional (strict sequence, stop-on-failure), 2) parallel best-effort (fanout, aggregate partials), 3) orchestrated retries (idempotent retries + dedupe keys).

mira_prod: Launch gating thoughts: must have per-call timeout, per-tool retry policy, and SDK helpers for 'wait-for-all' vs 'stream-partials'. Customers will push back if we lack deterministic ordering option.

jon_ml: For rerank/embeddings-heavy flows, teams need precise ordering so reranking happens after all async tool responses. Ordering lane is high-value.

sam_sre: SLA note — parallel fanout multiplies downstream calls and can cause error blasts. Need backpressure, per-route concurrency caps and circuit-breakers in platform defaults.

anya_se: Security constraints — Private deployments need allowlist controls and audit trails of external tool calls. Also require KMS/HSM for any brokered credentials.

ryan_eng: API sketch:
``` 
{
  "model":"x",
  "toolflow":{
    "mode":"parallel|ordered|orchestrated",
    "timeout_ms":2000,
    "retry_policy":{ "max_attempts":2, "backoff_ms":500 },
    "dedupe_key":"<optional>",
    "per_tool_overrides":{
      "web_fetch": {"timeout_ms":800},
      "db_query": {"timeout_ms":1200}
    }
  }
}
```
This keeps top-level API small but lets SDKs wrap ergonomics.

mira_prod: +1. Need explicit per-tool error handling modes: abort (stop whole flow), skip (continue without result), fallback (call fallback tool). Default should be safe (skip/fallback) for hosted.

elaine_pm: MVP scope suggestion: implement 'parallel best-effort' + per-tool timeouts + streaming partials from SDKs. Defer ordered transactional and rollback semantics to post-MVP (complex state & consistency).

jon_ml: Metrics/observability required: per-tool latency histograms, success_rate, downstream_error_rate, and token/cost attribution per tool so customers can optimize.

sam_sre: Rollout plan: gated beta for Dedicated & Private customers first. Hosted: 3-week canary with throttles and opt-in flag. Default enable only after smoke and customer trials.

anya_se: Compliance ask: include opt-out for payload retention, and a GDPR/PII note for any tool payloads that may contain user data.

elaine_pm: Action items: ryan -> tech spec w/ API shapes and idempotency guarantees; sam -> SLOs, concurrency defaults & circuit-breaker params; mira -> customer PRD and acceptance tests; jon -> metrics schema. Sync Wed 09:00. :thumbsup:
